text: Three test files pin construction and search results. libsufr/tests/oracle.rs builds every small input in table() under several flag sets and compares against a reference sort and LCP; an input starting with > is an inline FASTA. libsufr/tests/search.rs holds hand-derived search results on small inputs, opened in all eight storage and cap modes. sufr/tests/cli.rs pins the CLI; create_bytes_match_fixtures compares 12 fixtures byte for byte, each built with --write-lcp.
